messages:
claire: Heads-up on PR #4507: I added a short section on schema anchors for structured-output so consumers can reference sub-schemas, but two things broke in review: the Go SDK snippet uses `InvokeTool` with the old envelope shape, and the doc's inline link to the anchor ("#examples-extractor") points to the page but the anchor name changed after a headings cleanup.

omar: thanks. which old envelope shape? can you paste the Go bit?

claire: current unsafe example: `resp, _ := client.InvokeTool("summarizer", map[string]interface{}{"params": map[string]string{"text": text}})` should be `inputs` not `params`, and the helper is `Invoke` not `InvokeTool` in the latest Go SDK.

jess: good catch. also saw the TS snippet still references `function_call` in a comment. we should normalize comments to "tool call / envelope" everywhere.

kai: plan: 1) update Go snippet to `resp, _ := client.Invoke("summarizer", map[string]interface{}{"inputs": map[string]string{"text": text}})`, 2) fix anchor link to `#example-extractors` (singular) which matches the new heading, 3) remove legacy `function_call` comments and add a one-line migration pointer to the SDK migration guide. i'll push a small follow-up commit.

claire: also please add a one-line guardrail note: "When referencing schema anchors, prefer explicit stable headings (avoid auto-generated headings that can change in formatting PRs)." We got burned when a formatter changed a heading and the anchor name shifted.

omar: can we add a docs CI test that'll render the page and assert anchor exists? We have a tiny puppeteer job in docs CI we can reuse; just one line asserting document.querySelector('#example-extractors') exists.

jess: lg. i'll add a tiny change to the changelog entry so search picks up "Go SDK Invoke" and "anchor fix".

ci-bot: docs/link-checker running... found broken anchor for /docs/structured-output.md#examples-extractor -> 404.

kai: pushed commit: Go snippet -> Invoke + inputs, TS comment normalized, anchor -> #example-extractors, guardrail note added, CI anchor assertion test added. PTAL.

claire: quick review: looks good but the Go example used `map[string]string` for inputs which won't work for nested objects. change to `map[string]interface{}` to be safe.

kai: good catch, fixed and force-pushed.

ci-bot: docs/link-checker 1 all links + anchors resolved. docs/tests 1 anchor assertion passed.

merge-bot: ready to merge when green.

jess: changelog updated: "Docs: fix structured-output anchor and Go/TS examples; normalize function_call -> tool call wording" (id: docs-4507-anchor).

claire: thank you everyone. post-merge follow-up: i'll add a short note to the contributing guide suggesting not to rename heading text that will be referenced by anchors in migrating docs. will open a small PR.

kai: sounds good. merging now.

merge-bot: merged. closing thread.
